item: row 263: OSM daily diff cost read back from the Field data file
summary: 0.6 gate row B: scripts/osm_change_files_readback.py (stdlib) reads the osm-change-files.json member the Field data button saves (row 117), a piece set, or a Diagnostics zip, and prints per country the files applied and their cost (bytes, fetch and apply seconds: n, total, mean per file, largest), gaps and newest runs. Every absent figure prints its reason, never 0; only counts, country codes, sequence numbers and dates are printed; a reason outside the member's fixed words is withheld. Gate row B names the read-back path and stays OPEN.
